claim: For every 2-connected simple graph G of order n and every 2 <= k < n, the number a_k(G) of k-vertex sets inducing a connected subgraph is at least n.

exact_exhaustive.method: NetworkX graph_atlas_g; all non-isomorphic graphs in the atlas filtered for 2-connectivity; each vertex subset counted exactly.

random_screen.method: Fixed-seed G(n,p) sampling, p uniform in [0.2,0.6], retaining only 2-connected graphs, exact subset counts.

limitations: Finite computation only; it does not prove the conjecture. Random screening is not exhaustive. NetworkX 3.4.2 was used for graph generation and connectivity checks.
